text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an Arima Kinen crowded with rivals, 
Sakura Laurel stood at the very pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps competing and pushing each 
other to new heights with Narita Brian, 
she might just reach sights no one has 
ever seen before. Even to the "Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Let's reach that dream stage together." 
Sakura Laurel shared her newly sprouted 
dream with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer shared the same 
dream: two brilliant lights competing as 
they aimed beyond the sky—toward a 
distant, soaring peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel and her Trainer reaffirm 
their bond: they will continue to share 
and pursue the same dream.
